entries.name: params-missing
entries.detail: `pg` sends an empty `values` array as a simple query, so the oracle never reaches `Bind` for this case. PostgreSQL rejects a `Bind` that supplies fewer parameters than the prepared statement requires with `08P01` (`ERRCODE_PROTOCOL_VIOLATION`), which is the reply this repository returns.
signal: repo error 08P01: bind message supplies 0 parameters, but prepared statement "" requires 1
pglite error 42P02: there is no parameter $1
